summary_md: **lalamolly ([@lalamolly_](https://x.com/lalamolly_/status/2116372511529050500))** highlights *Global Convergence of Detailed Balanced Mass Action Systems* ([arXiv 2610.30808](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.30808)). The paper, written by AI agents, has Claude Opus 5.5 making research decisions, GPT 6 Astra writing proofs and Lean checking them. It settles a long-open case of the 1974 Global Attractor Conjecture.
